accordion.description: Questions and answers that open and close. Each row is one item: the question in the first column, the answer in the second.

commerce-account-header.description: The title bar of the customer account pages. One row: Title, the heading shown (default My account).

commerce-addresses.structureOnly: it is a Commerce drop-in and needs a live store.

footer.description: The site footer. It has no rows: it loads the footer document (/footer, or the page's footer metadata) and shows it at the bottom of every page.
footer.structureOnly: it loads the storefront's footer document, which exists only on a real storefront.

fragment.description: Shows another page of the site in place, so shared content is written once. The one cell holds the path of the page to show.
fragment.structureOnly: it shows another page of the site; on its own there is no page to show.

header.description: The site header and navigation. It has no rows: it loads the navigation document (/nav, or the page's nav metadata) and adds the search, account and cart controls.
header.structureOnly: it loads the storefront's navigation document and its sign-in, cart and search connect to the live store.

modal.description: A dialog other blocks open from code, for example for sign-in. It is not a block to place on a page.
modal.structureOnly: it is a helper other blocks call from code to open a dialog; its code expects a list of content to show, not an authored table, so placed on a page it fails.
